subject: Request: Invoice cadence waiver for Hearthwell Labs (quarterly + net90)
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@hearthwell.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Hearthwell Procurement <procurements@hearthwell.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice cadence request for upcoming POC and pilot

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday — Hearthwell is excited about Redwood for our inference workloads. Procurement asked me to confirm whether you can accomodate a quarterly invoicing cadence with Net-90 payment terms for our pilot and first year. Our fiscal grant schedules and university funding cycles mean we typically process vendor invoices on a quarterly basis and the Net-30 cadence would cause cashflow friction.

I attached a preliminary PO (PO_8742.pdf) and a one-page note from finance explaining timing. We understand non-standard terms are exceptional; if helpful, we can do a 25% upfront prepay and the remaining 75% on quarterly invoices. Happy to discuss alternatives.

Can you let me know the internal process for getting a waiver approved and an ETA? We need to present this to our procurement committee next Monday.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Cloud Engineering, Hearthwell Labs
alex.chen@hearthwell.com

Attachment: PO_8742.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@hearthwell.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice cadence request for upcoming POC and pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks for sending the PO and context. Short answer: we can consider a quarterly invoice cadence with Net-90 for pilot customers, but it requires deal-desk + finance + exec approval when the term deviates from standard Net-30.

Quick summary of the ask: quarterly invoicing + Net-90; customer offers 25% prepay up front. Attach: Hearthwell_Finance_Terms.docx which outlines suggested guardrails we typically ask finance/legal to include (payment triggers, late fee exceptions, PO matching).

Jonas — looping you in for pricing and deal implications.
Naomi — can you flag the finance requirements you would require to accept Net-90 on record (reserve practices, credit check, collections cadence)? If we need a prepaid deposit, is 25% acceptable?

Alex, would you be able to commit to: 1) signed SOW with clear milestone billing, 2) valid PO for the initial invoice, and 3) a named point of contact in procurement for collections? That will help speed approval.

I can escalate to Markus for an executive signoff if finance flags are manageable. We aim to get a decision before next Monday.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Hearthwell_Finance_Terms.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Invoice cadence request for upcoming POC and pilot — exec approval request

Markus — forwarding a request from Hearthwell (DEAL-87341) for quarterly billing + Net-90 for their pilot. Key commercial points below:
- ACV expected first year: $128k (pilot + initial usage).
- Customer willing to do 25% upfront prepay.
- Request driven by grant/fiscal calendar; procurement needs a formal waiver for non-standard cadence.
- Attachments: PO_8742.pdf, Hearthwell_Finance_Terms.docx in the original thread.

Why I think we should consider it: this is a strategic account in biotech vertical; runway for expansion into multi-region deployments. Accepting Net-90 with a limited credit exposure (prepay + milestone locked SOW) should be low risk and materially help close now rather than push out to next fiscal quarter.

Request: executive approval to grant a conditional cadence waiver for pilot only, subject to: 1) 25% deposit collected before kickoff, 2) finance sign-off on credit/reserve, and 3) legal to add PO-matching clause and collection remediation language. If approved, I'll finalize with procurement and confirm SOW milestones.

Naomi — any immediate flags from finance? If we need an alternate proposal (e.g., 50% deposit) call it out and we'll present both to the customer.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Sales — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Invoice cadence request for upcoming POC and pilot — exec approval request

Team —

I approve a conditional exception for Hearthwell (DEAL-87341) to support quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for the pilot, under the following conditions:
1) 25% deposit collected prior to kickoff (finance to confirm receipt).
2) Naomi to confirm credit hold and reserve approach; if questions remain, increase deposit to 40%.
3) Legal to include PO-matching and a 45-day payment reminder cadence before late-fee assessment; this exception is pilot-only and will expire at the end of the 12-month SOW unless renewed by exec review.
4) No additional discounts beyond previously approved pricing; any material pricing concession requires separate approval.

Jonas/Laura — pls confirm we will capture these terms in the SOW + procurement routing. Once finance confirms receipt of the deposit, communicate approval to Hearthwell and instruct procurement to route final SOW to Legal for PO clause insertion.

Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
